ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a benzene ring, and the benzene ring is connected to a nitrogen atom containing hydrogen; this nitrogen atom is further connected to a three-carbon chain. Near the right end of the three-carbon chain there is a C=C double bond, and the rightmost carbon is connected to an O-H group. A separate H+ is also drawn in the figure, and there are curved arrows; the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the remaining connectivity is HO-C=C-CH2-NH-phenyl, and H+ is an independent species. According to the draft method, encode the enol fragment from the oxygen end as O/C=C/C..., then attach the aminophenyl part CNc1ccccc1, connect the independent proton [H+] with a dot, and obtain SMILES: O/C=C/CNc1ccccc1.[H+].

method.method_draft: First ignore all curved arrows as instructed. Convert the remaining connectivity in the drawing into a molecular graph: HO-C=C-CH2-NH-phenyl, with a separate H+ species. Write the phenyl-substituted amine as CNc1ccccc1 attached to the allylic chain, encode the alkene/enol segment from the oxygen end as O/C=C/C..., and append the separate proton with dot notation. This yields O/C=C/CNc1ccccc1.[H+].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个苯环，苯环连接到一个含氢的氮原子；该氮原子再连接到一条三碳链。三碳链末端靠右处有 C=C 双键，最右端碳连接一个 O-H 基团。图中还单独画有一个 H+，并有弯曲箭头；题目要求忽略箭头。推理：忽略箭头后，剩余连通关系是 HO-C=C-CH2-NH-phenyl，并且 H+ 是独立物种。按方法草案从氧端编码烯醇片段为 O/C=C/C...，再接上氨基苯基部分 CNc1ccccc1，用点号连接独立质子 [H+]，得到 SMILES：O/C=C/CNc1ccccc1.[H+]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawn molecule: a benzene ring bonded to an NH group, the N also bonded to a methylene chain leading to a C=C double bond ending in an OH group, plus a separate proton H+ shown near the curved arrow. Use the slanted alkene drawing to assign the slash stereochemical form used in the candidate SMILES, and do not treat the curved arrows as bonds.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that asks for the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and explicitly says to ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply skeletal-structure-to-SMILES conventions: benzene as c1ccccc1, anilino nitrogen as Nc1ccccc1, the enol chain as O/C=C/CN..., dot notation for the disconnected proton, and [H+] for the positively charged hydrogen. Curved arrows represent electron movement only and are not encoded.
